description: The harness throws before any node runs if its QA spreadsheet id is empty, equals the production id, or the case id is not one of C1/C2/C3.
why_it_exists: The harness copies four production nodes byte-for-byte, including their Sheets writes. The only thing standing between a test run and the live legal register is this id comparison, so it is asserted at the very first Code node and again immediately before each write.

expect.error: QA PREFLIGHT: case_id must be C1, C2 or C3. Got: C4

assertions: An empty QA spreadsheet id throws 'QA PREFLIGHT: no QA spreadsheet id.'
A QA id equal to the production id throws 'QA PREFLIGHT: QA id equals the production id. Stopping.'
case_id is upper-cased before validation and must be one of C1, C2, C3.
Both the QA id and the production id are carried forward on the item so every later gate can re-compare them without re-deriving either.
target_unresolved_reason: QA-harness-only node (QA Preflight). No production unit.
